concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetici kişiyi, halk üzerindeki hüküm gücünü ve bu gücün ülkesini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hükümdar, yönetim, halk, ülke ve egemenlik ilişkisini birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın halk üzerinde emir, yasak ve yönetim yetkisi kullanmasıyla kurulan kamusal hükümranlıktır. Bu alan hükümdarı, yönetim gücünü, hükmedilen ülkeyi ve ilahi bağlamda mutlak egemenliği kapsar.

facets.statement: Hükümdar, halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyarak kamusal yönetim yetkisi kullanır.
Hükümranlık, yöneticinin halkı ve ülkesindeki etkili yönetim alanını kapsar.
İlahi bağlamda bütün varlık üzerindeki mutlak ve kalıcı egemenlik anlatılır.
Bir topluluk bir kişiyi başına geçirerek onu hükümdar konumuna getirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Halk üzerinde yönetim ve siyaset yetkisi kullanan kişi kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Soyut hükümranlığı, ülkeyi ve ilahi mutlak egemenliği dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Kamusal yönetim yetkisini taşıyan katılımcıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Halk ve ülke üzerindeki yönetim gücü soyut olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Hükümdar kişisini ve birini hükümdar yapma eylemini açıkça göstermez.
error_profile.preserves: Kamusal egemenlik ve yönetim gücünü korur.

error_profile.adds: Belirli bir mal veya hak üzerinde özel aidiyet ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün özel sahiplik dalıyla karışır.
error_profile.loses: Halk üzerinde emir, yasak ve siyaset yoluyla kurulan kamusal yönetimi kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: Denetim ve yetki unsurunu sınırlı biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, belirli bir malın kişisel sahipliğinden ve ilahi haberci varlığın adından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hükümdarı halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyan yönetici olarak tanımlar; hükümranlık, ülke, halk üzerindeki siyaset ve özellikle ilahi mutlak egemenlik bu kamusal yönetim çekirdeğinde birleşir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hükümdar ve hükümranlık çekirdeği korunur; ülke, mutlak ilahi egemenlik ve birini hükümdar yapma kullanımları kendi biçim ve kalıplarına bağlı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yetki, yöneticilik ve özel sahiplikle en açıklayıcı üç sınır yayımlandı, üstünlük, azletme ve unvanla ilgili daha uzak adaylar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hükümdarın halk üzerindeki genel kamusal yönetimini kurar; komşu dal yönetici kişiden bağımsız olarak belirli bir hak veya eylem alanında verilen yetkiyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hükümdar kişisi, ülkesi ve ilahi mutlak egemenlik de kapsama girer.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir hak veya eylem için bir kişiye verilmiş yetki de kapsama girer.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başkaları üzerinde geçerli yönetim ve yetki kullanmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı en üst kamusal hükümranlığa ve ülke ölçeğine yönelir; komşu dal ise atanabilen yöneticilik veya valilik makamını daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hükümdarlık, ülke ve mutlak egemenlik ölçeği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiyi yönetici olarak görevlendirme ve belirli yöneticilik makamı öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki alan da bir topluluğu yönetme yetkisini ve bu yetkiyi taşıyan kişiyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının nesnesi topluluk ve ülke, yetkisi ise kamusaldır; komşu dalın nesnesi belirli mal veya hak, yetkisi ise sahibin özel tasarrufudur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Halk ve ülke üzerinde kamusal yönetim ve siyaset vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli mal veya hak üzerinde kişisel aidiyet ve tasarruf vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da denetim, yetki ve hüküm kullanma düşüncesini paylaşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: والاسم الملك لأن يده فيه قوية صحيحة (maqayis)؛ الملك لله المالك المليك (ayn)؛ الملكوت ملك الله وملكوت الله سلطانه (ayn)؛ الملكوت من الملك (sihah)؛ المملكة سلطان الملك في رعيته (ayn;tahdhib)؛ له ملكوت العراق وعزه وسلطانه وملكه (tahdhib)؛ الملك هو المتصرف بالأمر والنهي في الجمهور (mufradat)؛ ملك القوم فلانا وأملكوه على أنفسهم أي صيروه ملكا (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu alanı halk üzerinde emir ve yasakla işleyen yönetim gücü etrafında toplar; hükümdar, hükümranlık, ülke ve ilahi mutlak egemenlik aynı kamusal yetki ekseninin farklı görünümleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: المَلِك والملوك؛ المُلك والسلطان والعز؛ ملك الناس وسياسة الرعية؛ المملكة؛ الملكوت وخاصة ملك الله
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد مِلْك اليد للمال؛ ولا مَلَك الملائكة

concept_gloss.applicability: Evlendirme, evlenme ve akdin gerçekleşmesi kullanımlarını ortak sözleşmesel çekirdekte toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Evlilik bağının akitle kurulması işlemini ve sonucunu korur.

concept_map.definition: İki kişi arasında evlilik bağını sözleşmeyle kurmak veya bu akdin gerçekleşmesidir. Kullanım, birini evlendirmeyi, evlilik akdine tanıklığı ve bir erkeğin bir kadınla evlenmesini kapsar.

facets.statement: Evlilik bağı, tarafları birbirine bağlayan bir akitle kurulur.
Bir kişi iki tarafın evlilik akdini kurarak onları evlendirir.
Evlilik akdinin yapıldığı tören veya ona tanıklık etme olayı adlandırılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin iki taraf arasında evlilik akdini kurduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Tarafın kendi evlenme eylemini ve akit törenini dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Akdi kuran dış katılımcının evlendirme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Taraflardan birinin evlilik bağına girdiği kalıplaşmış kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Evlendiren kişinin eylemini ve akde tanıklık olayını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Evlilik bağının taraf açısından kurulmasını korur.

error_profile.adds: Tek yanlı sahiplik ve nesneleştirme anlamı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Özel sahiplik dalıyla yanıltıcı biçimde karışır.
error_profile.loses: Karşılıklı evlilik akdini ve evlendirme olayını kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: Bir ilişki kurma düşüncesini çok dolaylı biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kullanım mal sahipliği veya insanı köleleştirme değil, yalnız evlilik akdi ve evlenme bağlamıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bütün örnekleri evlilik akdinin kurulması çevresinde toplar: birinin evlendirilmesi, bu akde tanıklık edilmesi ve erkeğin kadınla evlenmesi aynı sözleşmesel olayın farklı katılımcı görünümleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım evlilik akdiyle sınırlıdır; ad biçimindeki akit ve kadınla evlenmeyi bildiren kalıp ayrı yüzler olarak korunur, çıplak sahiplik anlamına genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tam eşdeğer evlilik akdi, bedelin belirtilmediği özel akit ve cinsel birliktelik alanıyla sınırlar yayımlandı, akrabalık ve bekleme süresi gibi yalnız tematik adaylar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verilen sınırlar bakımından iki dal aynı sözleşmesel evlilik olayını ifade eder ve olağan bağlamlarda birbirinin yerine kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da evlilik bağının akitle kurulmasını, evlenmeyi ve evlendirmeyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yalnız akdin kurulmasına ve evlenmeye yönelir; komşu dal evlilik akdinden cinsel birleşme ve bedenle ilgili örtmeceli anlamlara uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Evlilik bağını kuran akit ve evlendirme işlemi merkezde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: evlilik akdi ve cinsel birliktelik alanı
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Cinsel birleşme ve beden bölgesi için örtmeceli kullanımlar da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal evlilik ilişkisi ve bu ilişkiyi kuran akit bağlamında kesişir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnız evlilik bedelinin adlandırılmadığı özel akit türünü belirtir; odak dalında böyle bir kurucu sınırlama yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Evlilik akdinin genel biçimidir ve bedel şartına bağlı değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel ve bedelsiz belirtilen evlilik akdi
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Akdin kuruluşunda evlilik bedelinin belirtilmemesi özel koşuldur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da taraflar arasında evlilik akdi kurulmasını anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: كنا في إملاك فلان أي أملكناه امرأته (maqayis)؛ الإملاك التزويج قد أملكوه وملكوه أي زوجوه (ayn)؛ ملكت المرأة تزوجتها (sihah)؛ أملكنا فلانا فلانة إذا زوجناه إياها (sihah)؛ شهدنا إملاك فلان وملاكه وملاكه (tahdhib)؛ الملاك التزويج وأملكوه زوجوه (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu dalı evlilik akdinin kurulması olarak ortaklaştırır; evlendiren kişi, evlenen kişi ve akde tanıklık edenler aynı sözleşmesel olayın farklı katılımcılarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: عقد التزويج والإملاك؛ شهدنا إملاك فلان؛ ملك الرجل المرأة بمعنى تزوجها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ملك المال ولا استرقاق المملوك

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düzenin varlığını ve düzgün işlemesini kendisine borçlu olduğu unsur için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dayanılan unsur, ayakta kalma ve düzgün işleme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düzenin veya bedenin ayakta kalmasını, düzgün işlemesini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan temel dayanak unsurudur. Kalbin beden için bu işlevi görmesi verilen başlıca örnektir.

facets.statement: Bir unsur, daha büyük bir işin veya düzenin dayandığı ve onun düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temeldir.
Bu dayanak, işin doğruluğunu, sürekliliğini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan belirleyici koşul olur.
Kalp, bedenin işleyişinin kendisine dayandığı temel unsur olarak gösterilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin veya düzenin kendisine bağlı olduğu belirleyici unsur anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.loses: İşin doğruluğu ve tamamlanması sonucunu açıkça belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Bağımlılık ve ayakta tutma işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin onsuz yürümeyeceği temel unsur mecazlı ve doğal Türkçeyle anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.adds: Beden parçası üzerinden güçlü bir mecaz ve örgütsel önem çağrışımı ekler.
error_profile.preserves: Temel destek ve vazgeçilmezlik ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dayanak olan unsuru belirtir; nesnenin kendi iç sıkılığı veya sahiplik ilişkisi değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir işin ayakta kalmasını ve düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temel dayanağı açıkça tanımlar; kalbin beden için örnek verilmesi bu genel bağımlılık ilişkisinin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız dayanak bildiren belirtili kalıplarda geçerlidir; kökün çıplak biçimine genel bir temel veya öz anlamı yüklenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel ayakta tutma, iç sağlamlık ve somut yapısal destekle en açıklayıcı sınırlar yayımlandı, öz, köken, yerleşme ve sınıflandırma adayları uzak kaldı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı belirli bir iş veya beden için kurucu dayanağı kalıplaşmış biçimde adlandırır; komşu dal ayakta tutan araçları geçim ve beden dâhil daha geniş alana yayar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Anlam, dayanak bildiren belirli kalıplara bağlıdır ve bir işin doğruluğunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: temel dayanak ve yaşamı sürdüren unsur
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Geçim, bedenin beslenmesi ve genel olarak varlığı sürdürme araçları da kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin ayakta kalmasını ve işleyişini mümkün kılan temel unsuru anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı ayakta kalmanın bağlı olduğu unsuru gösterir; komşu dal ise ayakta kalan şeyin kendi içindeki sağlamlık niteliğini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ayakta kalmayı sağlayan belirli temel unsur adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnenin kendi parçaları arasındaki sıkılık ve tutarlılık adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bozulmadan veya çökmeksizin ayakta kalmasıyla ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal somut taşıyıcı parçaları ve yerleşmeyi öne çıkarırken odak dalı bir işin doğruluğunu ve devamını sağlayan işlevsel temele uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soyut işlerin veya bedenin işleyişine temel olan unsur da kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kaburga ve yapı direği gibi somut taşıyıcı parçalar öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da daha büyük bir bütünün üzerinde durduğu taşıyıcı unsuru anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: ملاك الأمر ما يعتمد عليه (ayn)؛ القلب ملاك الجسد (ayn;sihah;mufradat)؛ هذا ملاك الأمر وملاكه أي صلاحه (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, bir işin kendisine dayandığı ve onun düzgün kalmasını sağlayan temel unsurdur; kalbin bedenle ilişkisi bu bağımlılık yapısını somutlaştırır.

branches.what_is_ar: ما يقوم به الأمر ويعتمد عليه؛ القلب ملاك الجسد
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الملك للسلطان ولا ملك اليد

concept_gloss.applicability: Yol, vadi ve yerleşim kalıplarındaki orta, büyük veya bağlama göre sınır kesimini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yer türünü, orta veya ana kesimi ve bağlama bağlı kapsam değişmesini korur.

concept_gloss.text: yolun veya yerin orta ya da ana kesimi

concept_map.definition: Yolun, vadinin veya yerleşimin bağlama göre orta, ana ya da büyük kesimidir; vadi kullanımında sınır da bu adlandırmaya katılır. Söyleyişe göre bu kesim izlenecek bir güzergâh veya uzak durulacak bir yer olabilir.

facets.statement: Bir yolun veya vadinin orta ya da ana kesimi belirli bir kalıpla adlandırılır.
Vadi için orta kesimin yanında sınır, yol için ise büyük bölüm açıklaması da verilir.
Aynı biçim bir yerleşimin orta veya büyük kesimi için de kullanılır.
Bağlama göre kişi bu ana kesimi izlemeye ya da ondan uzak durmaya yönlendirilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun orta kesiminin izlenmesi veya boş bırakılması istendiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Yolun ana bölümü, vadinin sınırı ve yerleşimin merkezi kapsamlarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Yol ve orta kesim ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vadiye bağlı kullanımda kaynakların verdiği iki yer belirlemesini birlikte göstermek için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Yol ve yerleşim kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Vadi kullanımındaki orta ve sınır seçeneklerini korur.

error_profile.collision: İdari veya işlevsel merkez anlamıyla karışabilir.
error_profile.loses: Ana veya büyük kesim ile vadi sınırı seçeneklerini kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: Orta yerde bulunma özelliğini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım yol ve vadi kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır; her nesnenin genel ortası anlamına genişletilemez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yol ve vadi için orta kısmı açıkça verir, ancak vadi kullanımında sınır, yol kullanımında ise ana veya büyük bölüm de aktarılır. Bu yüzden dal yalnız geometrik orta nokta diye daraltılmamalı, yerin ortası, ana kesimi veya bağlama göre sınırı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yolun ortası veya ana kesimi, vadinin ortası veya sınırı ve yerleşimin merkezi yalnız belgelenmiş biçim ve kalıplarda korunur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yolun ana hattı, genel orta konum ve dönemeçle sınırlar yayımlandı, yolculuk, dağ yolu ve yer çıkışı gibi yalnız aynı alanda bulunan adaylar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı belirli yol, vadi ve yerleşim kalıplarında orta ya da ana kesimi adlandırır; komşu dal yolun güzergâh ve açıklık niteliğini daha genel işler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Vadi sınırı ve yerleşimin merkezi gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar da vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yolun doğrultusu, açıklığı veya izlenmesi gereken güzergâhı daha geniş biçimde kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yolun ortası, ana kısmı ve izlenen doğrultusu alanında örtüşür.

facets.statement: Su, yolcunun veya topluluğun işlerini yürütebilmesini sağlayan temel kaynaktır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın genel çekirdeğini, olumlu sonucu, zarar karşıtlığını ve iyiliğe eriştirme işlevini birlikte anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaştıran yarar

concept_map.definition: Zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmayı kolaylaştıran olumlu sonuç ya da etkidir. Bu çekirdek, birine yarar sağlama, bir şey aracılığıyla yarar elde etme ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olup zarar vermeyen kişiyi niteleme biçimlerinde gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Zararın karşıtı olan yarar, iyiliğe ulaşmada yardımcı olan olumlu bir sonuç veya etkidir.
Eylem yönü, yararın bir başkasına ulaştırılmasını veya o kişide yararlı bir sonuç doğurulmasını bildirir.
Belirli bir şeyle kurulan kullanım, kişinin o şeyden ya da onun aracılığıyla yarar elde etmesini bildirir.
Kişi niteliği olarak, insanlara sürekli yarar sağlayan ve onlara zarar vermeyen kimseyi anlatır.
Aynı yarar kavramı, kaynakta eşdeğer bir ad biçimiyle de ifade edilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişide olumlu ve yararlı bir sonuç doğurduğu eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yararın bir başkasına ulaştırılması ve onda olumlu sonuç doğurması yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin belirli bir şeyden veya onun aracılığıyla yarar elde ettiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yararı elde eden kişiyi ve yararın belirli bir şey aracılığıyla doğmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başkalarına sürekli yarar sağlayan ve onlara zarar vermeyen kişiyi açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Süreklilik taşıyan yarar verme niteliğini ve zarar vermeme sınırını birlikte korur.

error_profile.adds: Yararı yalnız kişinin kendini gözetmesine bağlayan bir çağrışım ekleyebilir.
error_profile.collision: Başkalarının iyiliğinden bağımsız kişisel gözetim anlamıyla karışabilir.
error_profile.loses: Zararın karşıtı olma ve iyiliğe ulaştırma çekirdeğini geri plana iter.
error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin kişiye yararlı sonuç sağlaması yönünü kısmen korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın sınırı genel yarar çekirdeğidir; bir şeyden yararlanma ve yararlı kişi anlatımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmada araçlık eden yarar çekirdeğiyle tanımlar; ayrıca birine yarar sağlama, bir şeyden yararlanma ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olma biçimlerini bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ilişkileri doğru biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kazanç, kişiye yararlı bir sonuç doğurduğu ölçüde odak dalla kesişir.

facets.statement: Parça yarılmış deriden yapılır ve deri su kabının iki yanından her birine bir tane yerleştirilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tabaklama sürecinin belirli aşamasındaki deri veya deri parçası.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı deri malzeme ve onun işlenmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal somut bir yapısal parçadır; komşu dal ise kabın dikişlerini suyla sıkılaştıran bir bakım veya hazırlama işlemidir. Ortaklık yalnız aynı iş senaryosundadır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi deri su kabının hazırlanması ve kullanılabilir duruma getirilmesi çevresinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği değnek adıdır; değnek alıp satmayı bildiren kullanım bu çekirdekten türemiş, kişiye bağlanan ayrı bir eylem yüzüdür.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi adı doğrudan değnek olarak tanımlar ve kişiye bağlanan türemiş kullanımı değnek alıp satmakla açıklar. Verilen dal çerçevesi nesne çekirdeğini ve ona bağlı ticaret kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan koruyabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel değnek adını çekirdek tutar ve kişiye bağlanan değnek alıp satma kullanımını ayrı bir türemiş yüz olarak belirtir; ticaret anlamı nesne adının tamamına yayılmaz.

text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

baseline.text: De ki: Allah'ın dışında size ne zarar ne de yarar vermeye gücü yetmeyen şeye mi kulluk ediyorsunuz? Oysa işiten ve bilen Allah'tır.

findings.text: Kulluk iddiası yakınlıkla değil, zarar ve yarar üzerinde gerçekten bağımsız tasarruf gücüyle sınanır.

activation_trace.role: Worship as obedient, humbled submission supplies the allegiance being questioned.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the criterion of real outcome control.
Loss, injury, and bad condition supply the adverse pole of the capacity test.
Benefit and assistance toward good supply the favorable pole of the capacity test.

changed_reading.after: The ayah cross-examines allegiance by demanding evidence of sovereign disposal over the full outcome range, harm and benefit.
changed_reading.before: The ayah merely rejects worship of another object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعْبُدُونَ ... يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive worship assigns allegiance, while ownership and disposal supply the test: the recipient would need actual command of both adverse and beneficial outcomes. The paired poles make efficacy, not prestige, the criterion.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains below or short of the goal supplies the deficient-intermediary geometry.
Otherness and lower rank identify the selected recipient as a substitute beneath the endpoint.
Taming and leveling a traveled road supplies the exploratory image of submission creating a route.

changed_reading.after: It also pictures devotion stopping at a near, lower intermediary and repeatedly smoothing a route that cannot reach the governing source.
changed_reading.before: The phrase simply means worshiping something besides God.

baseline_models.mechanism: The alternative is spatially and hierarchically short of the goal: other than God, nearer or lower than the endpoint. The path image within worship makes submission a route smoothed toward a deficient stopping place.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech supplies the public question and any spoken response.
Auditory apprehension supplies access to what is voiced.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access beyond the outward answer.

changed_reading.after: The names make the interrogation answerable under complete audit: spoken allegiance is heard and its actual ground is known.
changed_reading.before: The final names are a general doxological close after a power argument.

baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered interrogation closes with hearing and knowing. The answer and profession are audible, while their truth, intention, and concealed reality remain known; the power test is therefore also an audit of the respondent.

activation_trace.role: Obedient submission anchors the expanded sense of worship in the focus.
The repeated worship root places obedient submission directly in relation to taghut.
The ط غ ي mapping names taghut as a head of misguidance, identifying the authority receiving submission.
The parallel ط غ و mapping independently preserves taghut as the head of deviation and excess.

changed_reading.after: The addressee is also asked why obedient allegiance is yielded to an overstepping authority that cannot guarantee either feared or desired outcomes.
changed_reading.before: The addressee is asked only about ritual devotion to an inert rival deity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same worship root is attached to taghut, whose two packet mappings both image a head of deviation and overstepping. Worship in the focus can therefore include outcome-seeking obedience to transgressive authority, not only cultic address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition plus taghut as overstepping leadership; I infer that allegiance is given in hope of managed outcomes. A live alternative restricts ع ب د here to cultic worship.
structural_cues: 5:60 places عَبَدَ immediately before ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ in one clause.
5:76 repeats ع ب د as an interrogation addressed to plural agents.

activation_trace.role: Hearing supplies reception of the outward profession and answer.
Knowing supplies disclosure of the reality behind speech.
Uttered saying supplies the audible profession of belief.
Hiding and covering supply the concealed counter-layer behind the profession.
Divine knowing explicitly penetrates what the speakers conceal.

changed_reading.after: They expose the possible split between a spoken answer to the worship question and the concealed allegiance that the answer masks.
changed_reading.before: Hearing and knowing merely amplify divine omniscience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The profession 'we believe' and what is concealed are placed under divine knowledge. This sharpens the focus's hearing-knowing pair into an exterior-interior audit: voiced allegiance is heard and its hidden contradiction is known.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward saying, concealment, and divine knowledge; I assign hearing to the expressed layer and knowing to both layers. The names may alternatively be a non-partitioned pair of general attributes.
structural_cues: 5:61 joins قَالُوا آمَنَّا to يَكْتُمُونَ and says God knows the latter.
5:76 closes an imperative to speak with hearing followed by knowing.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the governing capacity whose operation the context displays.
Benefit supplies the favorable outcome later materialized as provision.
A fetter around the limb supplies the denied image of blocked divine capacity.
Breadth, increase, and bounty reverse constriction and supply open capacity.
The going out of wealth in expenditure turns capacity into distributed provision.
Uprightness and balanced standing supply the maintained order linked to provision.
An edible share and provision supplies the concrete benefit arriving from above and below.

changed_reading.after: Owning benefit includes the ability to keep provision open, ordered, and circulating rather than merely holding a stock.
changed_reading.before: Owning benefit is static possession of a favorable result.

context_deltas.mechanism: Boundness is reversed by extension and expenditure, then upright maintenance is linked to eating from above and below. True sovereignty is rendered as an unblocked capacity that circulates provision, while the focus rival cannot own even the benefit it is expected to deliver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constriction, extension, expenditure, uprightness, and food; I infer a flow from sovereign capacity through maintained order into provision. The two ayat may alternatively offer separate metaphors without one causal system.
structural_cues: 5:64 explicitly reverses a fettered hand with two outspread hands and expenditure.
5:66 makes eating from above and beneath follow the establishment of what was sent down.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive faculty missing from the human sequence.
Knowledge supplies complete apprehension rather than self-obscuring perception.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the repeated failure to recognize consequences.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supplies failed reception.
Divine sight closes the repeated blindness-deafness sequence with unfailed perception.

changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses a defective reception loop in the worshiper: repeated refusal to hear and perceive permits allegiance to what lacks outcome control.
changed_reading.before: The focus identifies only a defective object of worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated human blindness and deafness are set against divine seeing, then the focus names divine hearing and knowing. The worship error becomes a reversal of receptivity: impaired agents keep choosing deficient recipients while divine perception remains complete.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human sensory failure and contrasting divine faculties; I infer that failed receptivity helps reproduce false allegiance. A live alternative treats 5:71 as a local moral history unrelated to the focus's final names.
structural_cues: 5:71 repeats عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا on both sides of repentance.
5:71 closes with divine sight, while 5:76 closes with divine hearing and knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the contrast between a dependent recipient and the governing source.
Benefit anchors the sustenance that the embodied figures themselves receive.
Messenger and message locate the named figure within transmission rather than at the source of sovereignty.
Passing time and departed generations supply mortality and succession within the messenger class.
Taking food supplies the bodily act of receiving needed material.
Food as livelihood and good condition makes the received benefit explicit.

changed_reading.after: It is also an embodied dependency test: a recipient who must take in benefit cannot be promoted into the source that owns the outcome system.
changed_reading.before: The no-harm/no-benefit claim is an abstract denial of power.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messenger status, predecessors passing away, and the eating of food form an embodied dependency test. One who receives sustenance and belongs to a passing messenger sequence is a beneficiary within the system, not the sovereign source that owns harm and benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger status, passing predecessors, and food intake; I infer dependence on provision and vulnerability to succession, which exclude sovereign outcome ownership. Eating may alternatively function only as a concise sign of humanity.
structural_cues: 5:75 immediately precedes the focus and emphasizes that both named figures ate food.
5:75 places eating beside messenger succession; 5:76 then asks about ownership of harm and benefit.

activation_trace.role: A near or lower position short of the goal anchors the deficient destination.
A leveled, traveled road supplies the exploratory image of devotion making a repeated route.
Loyal following and succession supply the mechanism that keeps agents on the inherited route.
The inclination of desire supplies the directional pull behind following.
Repeated deviation from guidance and aim supplies accumulated route drift.
An extended path that is traveled supplies the missed governing course.

changed_reading.after: It is a practiced trajectory: desire and loyal imitation repeatedly smooth a path toward something near enough to attract but too low to govern outcomes.
changed_reading.before: Worship beyond God is a static error about an object's rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deficient nearness of duna and the road-leveling image in worship become a trajectory when following and loyalty attach to desire, producing repeated loss of the extended path. False worship is maintained by a route-making practice, not a single mistaken classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, following, desire, repeated deviation, and a path; I infer desire-driven over-elevation as the arrow leading to a deficient intermediary. These may alternatively be adjacent admonitions without one route mechanism.
structural_cues: The branchless root غ ل و at 5:77 word 5 names excess immediately after the focus.
5:77 repeats ض ل ل three times before ending with the path.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the stronger, ultimate level of agency being denied.
Inflicting harm on another supplies the proximate interpersonal causation that must remain morally legible.
Restraint and prevention supply the unrealized human capacity to interrupt harmful action.
A reprehensible act that should be repelled supplies the social harm requiring intervention.
The production of an act supplies accountable creaturely causation.

changed_reading.after: Creatures can cause and prevent proximate effects and remain accountable, but they cannot own, guarantee, or sovereignly dispose of the final harm-benefit field.
changed_reading.before: No creature has any meaningful capacity to harm or benefit another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failure to restrain reprehensible action presupposes meaningful human intervention and causal responsibility. Thus the focus's denial is best carried as denial of sovereign ownership and guaranteed disposal over outcomes, not denial that creatures can proximally harm, help, or block harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountable action and failed prevention; I distinguish proximate causal participation from sovereign ownership of final outcomes. A live alternative takes the focus's denial as rhetorical absoluteness while preserving the same practical responsibility.
structural_cues: 5:79 condemns a community for not stopping one another's reprehensible acts.
5:76 says the rival does not own harm or benefit for the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and response anchors the active rather than merely acoustic sense.
Knowledge anchors complete recognition of the response's truth.
Human hearing that understands and accepts initiates the response sequence.
Recognition by a distinguishing trace converts reception into acknowledged truth.
Easy abundant flow supplies the body's released response to recognition.
Tears and their channel specify the material that overflows.
Voiced saying turns inward recognition into public testimony.
A deed's recompense returning to its agent closes the response circuit as benefit.
The explicit link to what they voiced connects heard testimony to returned recompense.

changed_reading.after: They also open a positive response circuit: receptive hearing can become recognition and truthful speech whose benefit returns to the speaker.
changed_reading.before: The final names only warn that God monitors a false answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing becomes understanding, recognition releases an embodied overflow, speech becomes testimony, and recompense returns to the speakers because of what they said. The focus's hearing-knowing close is thus not only surveillance but one end of a responsive circuit that can issue in benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and returning reward; I add the directional chain hearing to recognition to embodied response to testimony to recompense. It may alternatively depict sincerity without defining a general hearing-benefit circuit.
structural_cues: 5:83 sequences hearing, visible overflow, recognition, and voiced belief.
5:85 explicitly makes recompense follow because of what they said.

remaining_uncertainties: The exact extent to which the hearing-knowing order intentionally partitions spoken and concealed layers remains uncertain.
The path model depends on carrying branch imagery across د و ن, ع ب د, and 5:77 rather than on syntax alone.
The ق ل ل and hydraulic readings are deliberately contained branch activations and should not control a conservative synthesis.
The boundary between denied independent ownership and permitted proximate efficacy is conceptually strong but supplied by reader inference.
strongest_changes: The immediately preceding food scene turns the abstract power denial into an embodied dependency test.
The failure of mutual restraint in 5:79 forces a distinction between proximate creaturely causation and sovereign ownership of outcomes.
The 5:83-85 sequence turns hearing and knowing from static surveillance into a reception, recognition, testimony, and recompense circuit.
The taghut occurrence expands worship from cultic address to obedient allegiance offered to overstepping authority.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converts the focus's compact harm-benefit test into mechanisms: metabolic dependence, circulating provision, social intervention, sensory reception, and desire-driven path formation. The closing divine names then govern both concealed allegiance and truthful response.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and rising supply an image of taking up the capacity challenge and setting it publicly in motion.
The repeated command carries the challenge onward into the next address rather than leaving it as a private inference.

changed_reading.after: Imagistically, the speaker is made to bear the criterion upright and carry it across successive public confrontations.
changed_reading.before: The speaker is instructed only to pronounce a question.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for قُلْ rather than its ordinary ق و ل sense. It remains anchored to the exact focus word and its repeated packet occurrence, but downstream prose should present it only as rhetorical kinesics, never as a lexical translation of قُلْ.

activation_trace.role: Water by which travelers can command their affairs supplies concrete sustaining control.
The side section of a water skin supplies a bounded carrier of life-supporting benefit.
Unimpeded flow expands carried benefit into an enduring provision channel.
A river cutting the earth with running water supplies the large-scale infrastructure of sustained benefit.

changed_reading.after: Benefit can be pictured materially as the capacity to carry, release, and maintain a life-sustaining flow, a capacity the proposed recipient lacks.
changed_reading.before: Benefit is an abstract favorable effect possessed by a patron.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines the water-control and water-container images inside focus م ل ك and ن ف ع with later flowing rivers. The exact packet branches keep it anchored, but it should be rendered only as a material analogy for sustaining capacity, not as the lexical meaning of نَفْعًا or a claim that 5:76 is specifically about water.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Worship is tested by effective disposal, not nearness.** `د و ن B001` is nearness short of a limit, `م ل ك B002` ownership/disposal, `ض ر ر B001` harm, and `ن ف ع B001` benefit. I infer that close-at-hand objects fail the agency test: they cannot direct either adverse or beneficial outcome, while divine hearing and knowledge reach the worshipper.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The worship claim is tested by independent disposal.** Fixed **م ل ك / B002** (“ownership and disposal”) is negated over both harm and benefit. 5:75 supplied bodily dependence on food, while 5:77 warns that desire-driven excess leaves the true path; 5:80–5:81 later apply the same alignment problem socially through *awliyāʾ*. I infer that a valid object of worship must not merely be associated with effects but possess their disposal. The question reads as a causal competence test, not only a prohibition by title.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:80–5:81 extended the causal competence test into social worship: what one treats as directing support reveals whether professed belief actually governs alignment.

words.gloss_range: imperative speech command launching a quoted polemical question
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens as a commanded speech-act, not detached narration. The singular messenger is ordered to deliver a question that immediately confronts plural addressees, so the word creates the speech frame for the whole ayah. It also belongs to recurring rebuttal and anti-idolatry challenge patterns, including the worship-and-incapacity formula in 6:71 and 21:66 and the Surah 5 command chain (5:17; 5:59; 5:77), with an abrupt clipped onset that suits the challenge.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, reciting, and uttering; local command selects mandated declaration

topics.headline: imperative opens the quoted challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is staged as a mandated utterance before the rebuke unfolds.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence identifies an imperative speech command governing the following quoted challenge.

topics.headline: command joins repeated rebuttal settings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is part of a broader challenge pattern rather than a one-off instruction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply same-surah and cross-surah parallels plus boundary movement into direct confrontation.

topics.headline: short command gives terse onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact sound as part of the force of the challenge.
topics.reason: The sound row links the clipped command shape with the ayah opening.

words.gloss_range: interrogative-rebuke imperfect for ongoing misdirected worship
words.prose: {{ar:أَتَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:ataʿbudūna}}) binds the question onset to the worship verb, making the clause a rebuke rather than a request for information. The local verb takes the following relative object, so the challenge is aimed at worship already headed toward what the ayah will define as powerless. The root field makes the act more than ritual labeling: agency and dependence are being yielded. The word also joins anti-idolatry formulae while 5:76 uniquely routes the proof through possession of outcomes (10:18; 21:66).
words.root_gloss_range: worship, service, servitude, and yielded dependence; local sense is worship with dependency pressure

topics.headline: question-form directly rebukes worship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb confronts an ongoing practice instead of asking a neutral question.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the prefixed interrogative as reproof, and the following proof confirms the rebuking force.

topics.headline: root field makes worship dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenged act is a relation of yielded dependence, not a thin ritual label.
topics.reason: The local verb takes the relative object, while lexical evidence supports worship, service, and servitude pressure.

topics.headline: formula turns into an outcome-control test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a known worship-besides-God challenge is sharpened here by the possession verb.
topics.reason: The rows link the word to formulaic parallels and to the local convergence of question force, worship semantics, and exclusion.

words.gloss_range: preposition forming the first half of the compound exclusion phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) does not function as simple origin here. It begins the compound exclusion phrase with the following noun, so separation from God qualifies the act of worship before the worshipped object is named. The independent written form lets source-separation and exclusion remain felt inside the idiom.

topics.headline: preposition starts the exclusion construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misdirected worship is first framed as separation from God before the powerless object is described.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the particle part of the compound phrase governing the following noun.

words.gloss_range: construct noun in the exclusion phrase with below/other-than force
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) gives the exclusion phrase spatial and rank pressure. It is governed by the preceding preposition and then governs the divine name, making God the standard relative to which the alternative is placed beneath or apart. The submission-lowness dispute remains a useful secondary pressure, and the phrase also belongs to the nearby Jesus-focused divine-identity argument, after 5:72-75 and before the direct interrogation about worship besides God in 5:116.
words.root_gloss_range: below, beneath, lower rank, and other than; local phrase selects exclusion with inferior-rank pressure

topics.headline: construct relation measures the alternative against God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alternative is syntactically defined relative to God, not merely listed beside Him.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the preposition and the first term of a construct with the divine name.

topics.headline: spatial lowness colors the idiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices inferior-rank pressure inside the idiom, while local grammar keeps the phrase as established exclusion.
topics.reason: The root range includes lowness and otherness; the local construction narrows that field to exclusion with rank pressure.

topics.headline: phrase resonates in the surrounding Jesus argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusion phrase is part of the surrounding divine-identity dispute, not an abstract polemic only.
topics.reason: The rows anchor the phrase in the surrounding section and in the same phrase at 5:116.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name as the standard being bypassed in worship
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) closes the exclusion phrase as the named standard of legitimate worship. Its genitive case keeps the divine name bound inside the phrase, so the false object is interpreted only after displacement from God has been established. The name field keeps worship-directedness primary while the awe or bewilderment derivation helps explain how misdirected devotion can attach to a false object. The later nominative recurrence reverses the role: first God is the bypassed standard, then God is the asserted subject of the attribute seal, with sovereignty and witness parallels nearby (5:17; 5:41).
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship-directedness, with awe or bewilderment as secondary pressure

topics.headline: divine name anchors the exclusion phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that false worship is measured against the named divine referent, not against a vague deity category.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive second term of the construct phrase.

topics.headline: name field supplies worship-worthiness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship-directedness and awe pressure, while the local role remains the proper name in a genitive phrase.
topics.reason: The derivational evidence is relevant to worship-worthiness but cannot override the local proper-name construction.

topics.headline: first case prepares later reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from God as bypassed standard to God as positive subject of hearing and knowledge.
topics.reason: The rows track the two divine-name occurrences and relate them to same-surah sovereignty and witness closures.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun functioning as worship object and antecedent of the incapacity clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) pivots from the act of worship to the object being tested. On the main relative reading, the same word receives worship and then becomes the antecedent whose clause says it does not possess control. Its non-personal force presses the worshipped category downward even within the surrounding personal Christological pressure, while a possible interrogative shadow can intensify the rebuke without displacing the relative parse.

topics.headline: relative object carries the proof inside it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worshipped object is grammatically introduced as the one lacking control.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as relative, attachment makes it the direct object, and the following clause modifies it.

topics.headline: non-personal form lowers the worshipped category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices depersonalizing pressure on the worshipped category, while the grammar does not settle every historical referent by itself.
topics.reason: The form is relative locally; the non-personal contrast is meaningful but must remain qualified.

topics.headline: possible question-force sharpens the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object itself can feel questioned, though the relative clause remains the controlling parse.
topics.reason: The input preserves the interrogative possibility, but QAC and attachment favor the relative function.

words.gloss_range: first negator over the imperfect possession verb, opening total incapacity
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the categorical denial of possession. Because it stands before an imperfect sovereignty verb, the denial is a standing lack of control, not a past non-event. Its later repetition creates a two-beat no-no frame so both harm and benefit receive explicit exclusion.

topics.headline: negator states standing non-possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause denies capacity as such, not just a single failed act.
topics.reason: The negator scopes over the imperfect possession verb inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: first negator opens the no-no frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is structured in two explicit beats rather than left to one broad negator.
topics.reason: The row set treats the first negator as the opening of a paired denial.

words.gloss_range: negated Form I imperfect of possession/control governing the outcome pair
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْلِكُ}} ({{tr:yamliku}}) is the proof verb inside the relative clause. Its singular agreement locks the subject back to the relative pronoun, and the negation runs through the affected addressees and both outcome nouns. The root field expands the denial toward sovereignty over outcomes, while broader branches remain background; the same verb also resonates with the sovereignty question in 5:17.
words.root_gloss_range: possession, ownership, dominion, kingship, and related agency; local verb selects possession/control over outcomes

topics.headline: verb locks incapacity to the worshipped object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of worship itself is made the subject of a standing non-possession claim.
topics.reason: The verb is 3ms imperfect, with dative and object arguments supplied by the local clause.

topics.headline: possession expands into control over outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial reaches rule and control over outcomes, while the local verb remains possession/control rather than every root branch.
topics.reason: The root range includes ownership and rule; local grammar narrows it to control of harm and benefit.

topics.headline: same verb participates in Surah 5 sovereignty argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this incapacity claim belongs to a wider same-surah argument about real power.
topics.reason: The rows compare this verb with 5:17 and connect it to the control-of-outcomes field.

words.gloss_range: dative phrase marking the plural addressees as affected party
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) makes the proof personal. The addressees are not only accused worshippers; their own harm and benefit are what the false object cannot control. By placing the fused preposition-pronoun before both outcome nouns, the wording anchors the whole merism to them before it unfolds, and 7:188 shows the same affected-party slot in a self-disclaimer frame.

topics.headline: dative suffix personalizes the proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument concerns outcomes for the addressees themselves, not abstract power alone.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a preposition with plural suffix, and attachment evidence makes it the beneficiary complement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative harm as the first object in the denied outcome pair
words.prose: {{ar:ضَرًّا}} ({{tr:ḍarran}}) is the first outcome named under the negated possession verb. Its accusative case keeps harm inside the sovereignty test, and its indefinite form lets any instance of adversity fall under denial. The root field adds pressure from damage, distress, and necessity, while its pairing with the benefit term makes a full outcome spectrum the false object cannot command.
words.root_gloss_range: harm, damage, adversity, loss, distress, and coercive necessity; local noun covers any adverse outcome

topics.headline: harm is an accusative object under non-possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harm is not a loose circumstance but an object of the denied control claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as an accusative object of the possession verb.

topics.headline: harm carries adversity and begins the merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial covers adverse outcomes broadly and pairs them with benefit exhaustively.
topics.reason: Lexical rows support a broad harm range, and the local pair forms an outcome merism.

topics.headline: harm term belongs to wider outcome-control proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harm is part of a recurring control-of-outcomes formula applied to false worship.
topics.reason: The contextual rows connect the harm term to possession, benefit, and polemical recurrence.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector before the renewed negation of benefit
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second outcome to the first without collapsing them. Attached to the next negator, it makes benefit both coordinated with harm and separately denied. The particle is the hinge that lets the pair register as a balanced merism rather than an afterthought.

topics.headline: connector binds and separates the benefit pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second outcome is joined to harm while still receiving its own negated force.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the conjunction, and attachment evidence coordinates the benefit noun with the harm noun.

words.gloss_range: second negator renewing denial at the benefit pole
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) returns before the positive pole, so benefit is not merely swept along by the first negator. The repeated particle assigns explicit denial to advantage itself: the worshipped object cannot harm, and it also cannot provide benefit. That repetition makes the polarity audible and structurally balanced.

topics.headline: second negator denies positive efficacy separately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inability to benefit receives its own explicit denial, not a residual place under the first negation.
topics.reason: The second negator precedes the coordinated benefit noun and reinforces total negation of the outcome pair.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative benefit as the positive pole of the denied outcome pair
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْعًا}} ({{tr:nafʿan}}) completes the outcome pair. Its matching accusative indefiniteness means any benefit or usable advantage is denied to the false object's control, not just one named good. The order after harm fits this rebuke, while 7:188 reverses the pair in a prophetic self-disclaimer, showing the same control-of-outcomes test from another discourse angle.
words.root_gloss_range: benefit, usefulness, profit, utility, and advantage; local noun covers any positive yield

topics.headline: benefit is coordinated as an accusative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that benefit is denied as carefully and grammatically as harm.
topics.reason: The noun shares the accusative object role through coordination and indefinite form.

topics.headline: benefit means usable positive yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied positive pole includes practical usefulness, profit, and advantage.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supplies benefit and utility senses, and the pair supplies the exhaustive outcome frame.

topics.headline: parallel order shift clarifies role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same pair can be ordered differently when the discourse role changes, as in 7:188.
topics.reason: The rows compare this rebuke with 7:188 and connect the outcome pair to the later attribute pair.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening the corrective nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the ayah from stopping at the negative proof. It turns from the powerless object to the positive divine assertion, so the closure is corrective rather than merely dismissive. A circumstantial shade is possible, but the local grammar primarily resumes with a new nominal clause whose subject and separating pronoun build the attribute seal.

topics.headline: parse options share contrastive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that either parsing keeps the final attribute claim tied to the preceding rebuke, while resumption remains primary.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows preserve two parse options; QAC and clause evidence favor independent resumption.

topics.headline: connector pivots to divine attribute assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refutation is completed by a positive claim about God, not by negation alone.
topics.reason: The remaining rows track the connector as a pivot into the independent nominal seal.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as subject of the final attribute seal
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) re-enters in nominative case as the subject of the final clause. The same divine name has moved from the standard being bypassed to the one positively asserted, and the definite predicates make the closure an identity claim rather than a loose description. This return completes the reversal: misdirected worship is measured against God, then God is named as the one who hears and knows.
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship-worthiness; local proper name receives hearing and knowledge predicates

topics.headline: divine name begins the attribute predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause asserts God as the subject who bears the decisive attributes.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word nominative, and attachment evidence makes the following attributes predicates of this subject.

topics.headline: genitive-to-nominative recurrence enacts reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument moving from God as bypassed reference point to God as asserted possessor of perceptive attributes.
topics.reason: The rows compare the first genitive occurrence with this nominative occurrence and tie the shift to the attribute pair.

words.gloss_range: independent separating pronoun marking exclusive predication
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stands where Arabic could have moved directly from subject to predicate. As a separating pronoun, it prevents the first attribute from collapsing into a mere adjective and makes the final clause an identifying assertion. It also sharpens exclusivity: after the false object is denied control, God is isolated as the one to whom the hearing-knowing attributes belong. The pronoun helps the movement from the prior commanded looking to divine comprehensive perception land inside the final clause.

topics.headline: separating pronoun forces predicate status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final attributes are asserted as predicates, not merely attached as descriptive epithets.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a separating pronoun between subject and predicate, and attachment evidence supports the predicate relation.

topics.headline: pronoun isolates God after the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive attributes are restricted away from the worshipped object and centered on God.
topics.reason: The rows link the separating function to exclusivity in an argument structured by prior denial.

topics.headline: human observation yields to divine perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a transition from commanded human observation to divine hearing and knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary row ties the preceding observation frame to the final divine perception claim.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive predicate title, the All-Hearing, beginning the final attribute pair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمِيعُ}} ({{tr:al-samīʿu}}) begins the attribute pair as a predicate title after the separating pronoun. Its definite intensive shape names stable, comprehensive hearing, not occasional sound reception. In the worship argument, hearing means receptive and responsive awareness of utterance and prayer; Abraham's critique of worshipping what does not hear makes the contrast explicit (19:42).
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, heeding, and responsive awareness; local divine title names comprehensive hearing

topics.headline: definite intensive attribute begins the seal

topics.reason: The word follows the separating pronoun as predicate, bears definiteness, and uses the intensive pattern identified in the rows.

topics.headline: hearing includes receptive response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attribute answers worship as address and prayer, not merely sound as a physical phenomenon.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence includes hearing, listening, and heeding, and the worship context calls for responsive perception.

topics.headline: formula specializes the worship challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar hearing-knowing pair is not generic closure here; it names capacities the false object lacks.
topics.reason: The rows supply the repeated attribute-pair frame and the concrete 19:42 parallel.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive predicate title, the All-Knowing, completing the final attribute pair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿalīmu}}) lands the ayah on comprehensive knowledge as its final word. It matches the prior attribute in definite intensive form, completing a balanced title-pair rather than adding a loose adjective. The root field adds knowing that can distinguish, disclose, and mark reality, so the closure answers both the commanded speech at the opening and the worshippers' inward condition: the powerless object lacks outcome-control, while God hears and knows.
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, teaching, distinguishing by signs, and comprehensive awareness; local divine title names exhaustive knowledge

topics.headline: second definite intensive predicate completes the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is a stable divine title of comprehensive knowledge, formally matched to the hearing title.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make it a second predicate, and the rows identify the definite intensive form.

topics.headline: knowledge field exposes reality and intent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge covers intent, condition, and the exposed impotence of what is worshipped.
topics.reason: Lexical rows connect knowledge with teaching, signs, and distinguishing marks, and the local context applies that field to worship and incapacity.

topics.headline: final word closes the argument in divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by generalizing the specific rebuke into a divine hearing-knowing principle.
topics.reason: The final-position and discourse rows tie the last word to the ayah opening, the local knowledge thread, and the exclusive seal.
